pos.personaBrief: Real Madrid 2021-25 ceded possession (45.7%, 43.8%, 40.8% in the 2021/22 knockouts), sat in a low block and countered; he said the counter becomes lethal with the right strikers, and efficiency was the key.

pro.personaBrief: Counter-attacking Madrid (Wikipedia, Bayern 'more direct, more vertical') attacks fast after recovery, yet he built from the back with 3v2 overloads and valued regista Pirlo and Alonso.

est.personaBrief: Described as relational and fluid (4-3-3 shifting to 4-4-2/4-3-1-2, Rodrygo joining Vinicius, 'I do not know if it was 4-3-3 or 4-4-2'), giving players individual interpretation.

lar.personaBrief: Mixed: Bale/Ronaldo/Vinicius wide forwards and full-backs gave width, but he used Di Maria as 8, Christmas tree and 4-3-1-2 with narrow midfields and central bodies.

blo.personaBrief: At Real Madrid he preferred a mid/low block, 'our pressing isn't too high up', and told players not to press Shakhtar; the high-press attempts were occasional.

mar.personaBrief: Open play is zonal-based with man-oriented pieces (CBs tight on the striker); corners are zonal line plus blockers (TFA).

pla.personaBrief: Shape suits the players and the opponent ('get the shape to suit the players', 'I am not concerned with my identity'); he adjusted pressing and block by match.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic and efficient: low block, counter, dropped deep after going ahead in the 2022 final; more focused on winning than on style.

sis.personaBrief: Man-manager who modifies tactics for his players, gives Vinicius and Rodrygo freedom, and spared stars like Ronaldo; trust in individuals over system.

jog.personaBrief: Built teams around technical players such as Pirlo as regista, Modric, Kroos, Alonso, Zidane; chose passing quality for the pivot.

bas.personaBrief: Relies on proven veterans such as Modric and Kroos on one-year renewals and signs stars; refuses to use fringe players, and prefers experienced winners.

lid.personaBrief: The 'diva whisperer': treats players as people first, consults them on tactics, and keeps a calm, harmonious dressing room; the Ibrahimovic box kick is the exception.
